name: Gujarat Textile Policy: Payroll Assistance (Fiscal Incentives to Labour Intensive Unit)
benefit: **Activity****Payroll Assistance**Garment, Apparel&amp;amp; Made-ups (including Composite Unit) ₹5,000/- per Female Worker &amp;amp; ₹4,000/- per Male Worker per month for a period of 10 yearsTechnical Textile (including Composite Unit) ₹3,000/- per Female Worker &amp;amp; ₹2,000 per Male Worker per month for a period of 10 years
_eligibility_text:
1. The industrial unit must be recognized as a Labour Intensive Unit.
1. The scheme is applicable to industrial units in the Garment, Apparel & Made-ups, and Technical Textile sectors (including Composite Units).
1. The workers must be domiciled in Gujarat and registered under the EPF scheme.
1. The unit must apply within one year from the Date of Commercial Production (DoCP).
